summary: Collins states his faith compels him to support Israel and rebukes Ossoff for voting against weapons sales to Israel. Vote for Peace, which evaluates candidates on human-rights and war-lobby grounds, opposes him in the general. His recorded Nay on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, is the one documented action in the record that runs against an Israel-defensive posture, though the vote alone does not establish its rationale.
